statements.statement: The patient presents with persistent palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The patient has sick sinus syndrome
The patient has a history of unspecified atrial fibrillation (I48.91)
The denial reason code is CO-22
The denial is based on coordination of benefits protocols indicating care may be covered by another payer
Extended rhythm monitoring is necessary to assess arrhythmia burden and guide rate control management
